meta.title: Talea — Everything in China. One partner.
meta.description: Sourcing, quality control, shipping and warehousing out of China — handled by one accountable team on the ground.

hero.subtitle: Sourcing, quality control, shipping and warehousing — handled by one team on the ground.
hero.badge1: Team on the ground in China

process.heading: Where does it begin?
process.subtitleWide: Seven steps between a thought and a pallet in your warehouse. You are told where you are at every one of them.
process.subtitleNarrow: Seven steps between a thought and a pallet in your warehouse.

steps.title: Everything begins with an idea
steps.body: A product, a market, a hunch. You tell us what you want to sell and who you sell it to.

steps.title: We help you narrow it down
steps.body: Specs, materials, packaging and a target landed price — we turn the idea into a brief a factory can quote.

steps.title: We find the right source
steps.body: We shortlist verified factories, visit and audit them on the ground, and bring you comparable quotes instead of promises.

steps.title: We negotiate, contract, and place your order
steps.body: Price, terms, samples and payment protection agreed in writing before anything is made.

steps.title: We coordinate delivery, QC, and prepare for shipment
steps.body: In-line and pre-shipment inspection, then consolidation, labelling and every export document signed off.

steps.title: Your goods are on the way
steps.body: Sea, rail or air. Booking, insurance and tracking handled, with customs cleared at both ends.

steps.title: You receive what you were waiting for
steps.body: Delivered to your warehouse or held in ours. What you approved is what arrives.

who.heading: A partner, not a middleman
who.midText: Sourcing from China is easy to start and hard to trust. Talea replaces the chain of brokers, agents and forwarders with one accountable team that is physically there — in the factory, at the port, and on the paperwork.
who.midSub: Offices in Shanghai. Sourcing staff and inspectors across Guangdong, Zhejiang and Fujian.

testimonial.quote: Talea are our eyes and ears in China. Reliable, responsive, and genuinely invested in our success.
testimonial.name: Mike Morgan

services.heading: Where are you starting from?
services.subtitle: Pick the situation that sounds like yours.

scenarios.label: I'm sourcing for the first time
scenarios.headline: We take you from idea to first container
scenarios.body: You have a product in mind and no supply chain behind it. We turn the idea into a technical brief, find and audit candidate factories, and walk you through samples, terms and shipping so nothing is a surprise.
points: Sample rounds managed end to end

scenarios.label: I already have a supplier
scenarios.headline: We become your team on the ground
scenarios.body: Keep the factory you trust. We handle the parts that are hard from a distance: production follow-up, inspection before money moves, consolidation, export documents and freight.

scenarios.label: I want to build my own brand
scenarios.headline: Private label, from packaging to pallet
scenarios.body: We match your product spec to factories that can hold it, manage artwork, packaging and compliance marks, and keep your suppliers separated from your customers.

scenarios.label: I need QC & inspection
scenarios.headline: Eyes in the factory before you pay
scenarios.body: Our inspectors work to your checklist — during production and before shipment — and you get a photo-documented report while there is still time to fix things.

scenarios.label: I need warehousing only
scenarios.headline: Store, consolidate and release on your schedule
scenarios.body: Hold stock in China while you consolidate orders from several suppliers, then release shipments when your market needs them rather than when the factory finishes.

cta.heading: Ready to source with confidence?
cta.subtitle: Tell us what you want to sell. We come back with sources, real prices and a plan to get it to your warehouse.
cta.note: No obligation. A reply within one working day.

footer.tagline: Moving goods, building trust. End-to-end sourcing, quality control and logistics out of China.
